_about: Every public-domain John Flavel (1630?-1691, Dartmouth) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is the complete Whole Works (London: W. Baynes, 1820, six volumes), Internet Archive OCR text, raw and unconverted (the Edwards precedent). CCEL ThML is clean and structured and is fetched for every CCEL title. No Gutenberg Flavel exists (searched 2026-10-02). Modern reprints (1930 onward) are excluded: their editorial matter may be in copyright.

_held.flavel-fountain: already in pipeline/fetch_sources.py CCEL dict (The Fountain of Life); not refetched here
